name: clean_withdraw_under_lock
title: Withdrawals from a wallet
body: Adds Wallets.withdraw for the payout endpoint, which runs on the request threads. Check and debit happen under the same lock.
diff:
### payments/wallets.py (modified, +10/-0)
@@ -15,3 +15,13 @@
     def balance(self, wallet_id: str) -> int:
         with self._lock:
             return self._balances.get(wallet_id, 0)
+
+    def withdraw(self, wallet_id: str, cents: int) -> None:
+        """Take `cents` out; called from the request threads."""
+        if cents <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("cents must be positive")
+        with self._lock:
+            have = self._balances.get(wallet_id, 0)
+            if have < cents:
+                raise InsufficientFunds(wallet_id)
+            self._balances[wallet_id] = have - cents
